keycloak.guideOidcStep1: Go to Keycloak Admin Console → Clients → Create client
keycloak.guideOidcStep2: Client type: OpenID Connect. Client ID: portal (or custom)
keycloak.guideOidcStep3: Client authentication: ON. Authentication flow: Standard flow + Service accounts enabled
keycloak.guideOidcStep6: Client scopes → configure attribute mappers for department, job_title, phone from User attributes to JWT claims
keycloak.guideSyncStep2: Client ID: portal-sync. Client authentication: ON. Standard flow: OFF. Service accounts enabled: ON
keycloak.guideSyncStep3: Service account roles tab → Assign role → Filter by client: realm-management → select view-users
keycloak.guideSyncStep4: Credentials tab → copy Client Secret. Without view-users role the test will return 403.
keycloak.guideNoteText: The main OIDC client handles user logins. The sync client has minimal permissions (view-users only, no realm-admin) for reading the employee directory. This reduces risk if the secret is compromised.
